Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of this game! The action from the U-19 World Cup 2022 continues and we have a lot of exciting games lined up. Although, you can join us for India's next game in the U-19 World Cup to catch all the live coverage. India Under-19 will face Uganda Under-19 on Saturday, 22nd January 2022. The first ball of this clash will be bowled at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT). But as you all know, the buildup will begin well in advance. So please tune in early. Till then, Adios!

Nishant Sindhu, the skipper of India Under-19, says that he is very happy, and the team is performing well and they will continue to do the same. On being asked about how things were after the covid scenario in their camp, he mentions that it was not easy with everything happening, but they were focused which helped them win the game. Adds that all the support staff and the coaches have been very supportive and have backed them throughout.

Tim Tector, the skipper of Ireland Under-19, credits India Under-19, he says that India put pressure on them straightaway. He adds that they did not bowl pretty well and they pulled things back later on by picking up some wickets and were happy to restrict India Under-19 to just over 300 runs, only because it was a good surface to bat on. Mentions that they were put on the back foot straightaway, maybe they could have been more proactive. Concludes by saying that they are playing South Africa Under-19 next and are looking forward to that game.

Harnoor Singh is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that the wicket was quite slow. Adds that the wicket was flat and good to bat on. Tells that they played well as a unit and he was playing according to the situation. Mentions that Rajvardhan Hangargekar was unbelievable with the bat at the end overs and they are very happy with his batting. Says that they have the backing of VVS Laxman and are looking forward to the next game.
...THE PRESENTATION...

India Under-19 bowlers were brilliant with the ball right from the word go and they never let the Irish batters settle in. All the bowlers chipped in when needed and this has been a comprehensive performance from them. The new ball bowlers set the tone up front and picked crucial wickets. Spinners came to bowl later on and they kept things tight in the middle. The Indian bowlers did not give any freebies whatsoever to the Irish batters and that resulted in them picking up wickets at regular intervals. A total of 8 bowlers were used by captain Nishant Sindhu and none of the bowlers disappointed him. All in all, it was a comprehensive performance from India Under-19 as Ireland Under-19 were blown away by the Men in Blue.

Ireland batters had their task cut out, chasing a target of over 300 and one would think that they will go hard in the Powerplay. But, the Irish batters did now show any intent whatsoever in the first 10 overs and also lost 3 key wickets in the process. Their innings never really got going and nothing went their way. Joshua Cox held one end but he struggled to rotate the strike and as a result, he too perished. Scott MacBeth came in to bat later on and he was the only batter who showed some intent but it was too late for Ireland Under-19. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals and fell short by a huge margin in the end.

What a dominant display this has been from India Under-19! They secure their second consecutive win of the tournament and are through to the Super League Quarter Finals! Ireland Under-19 were completely outplayed in this game and they would be very disappointed with their performance.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a way to finish! A tossed up delivery, on middle. Muzamil Sherzad looks to slog-sweep this towards deep mid-wicket, he got all the elevation but no distance. Raj Angad Bawa at deep mid-wicket, runs forward, dives to his left and takes a stunner to wrap things up. INDIA WIN THE GAME BY 174 RUNS!

Jack Dickson looks to defend off the back foot but he misses and gets rapped on his pad. Rajvardhan Hangargekar appeals and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Ireland Under-19 lose their second wicket inside first 5 overs and they are in a spot of bother.

DROPPED! Another chance goes begging! This one was a bit more tough than the previous one though! Back of a length, outside off. Jack Dickson stays back and looks to punch it through the cover. It takes the thick outside edge towards the gully fielder. The fielder there flies across to his right to grab it but he only gets a hand on it and puts it down.
BEATEN! Back of a length, outside off and jagging back in sharply. Jack Dickson looks to drive but the ball sneaks through his bat and pad to the keeper.
On a length, around off. Jack Dickson stays back to defend.

DROPPED! Jack Dickson SURVIVES! Good-length ball, just outside off and curling away late. Jack Dickson has a poke at it and the ball goes off the thick outside edge to the right of the keeper. The keeper moves to his right and looks to grab it but he fails to do so.
Back of a length, around middle. Jack Dickson tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Jack Dickson walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ravi Kumar strikes and Ireland Under-19 lose their first wicket cheaply! This was a length ball, around middle. Liam Doherty hangs back and looks to flick but the ball gets a bit big on him. It goes off the leading edge, in the air behind the mid-wicket fielder. Vicky Ostwal there, backtracks, settles under it and takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Vicky Ostwal b Ravi Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length ball, on off. Liam Doherty pushes it towards mid off.
FOUR! CARESSED! First boundary of the innings! Fuller in length, just outside off. Liam Doherty lunges forward and drives it past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Liam Doherty taps it towards backward point.
Throws the kitchen sink at it but does not connect! Full ball, way outside off. Liam Doherty looks for an expansive drive but the ball beats his outside edge.
Good-length ball, on off. Liam Doherty prods and defends it out.
Good running! Back of a length, outside off. David Vincent stays back, opens the face of his bat and steers it past the diving point fielder. Vincent comes back for the second run.
Full ball, outside off. David Vincent drives hard but straight to the man at cover.
Back of a length, outside off. David Vincent gets on his toes and blocks it out towards point.
A low full toss, outside off. David Vincent drags it towards mid off.
On a length, outside off. Liam Doherty prods, opens the face of his bat and steers it to third man for a run.
Wide! This is a length ball, angling down leg. Liam Doherty misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Good-length ball, shaping away a touch from off. Liam Doherty defends it to the off side with soft hands.
Slightly shorter in length, around off. David Vincent defends it to the off side.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. David Vincent looks to cut but he misses.
Good-length ball, outside off and angling across the batter. David Vincent looks to punch it through covers but he does not get any bat on it.
On a length, around leg. Liam Doherty tucks it to the leg side and takes off for a quick run.
Top effort from the fielder at cover. Length ball, outside off and inviting the batter to drive. Liam Doherty drives but the fielder at cover dives to his left and stops a certain boundary.
Kumar begins with a length ball, just outside off. Liam Doherty prods and pushes it to cover.
Ravi Kumar will bowl from the other end.
Good-length delivery, around off. David Vincent covers the line of the ball and defends. Just 1 run off the first over. Good start from Rajvardhan Hangargekar.
On a length, around off. David Vincent keeps it out watchfully.
Fuller in length, well outside off. David Vincent looks to drive it through cover but he misses as the ball beats his outside edge.
Back of a length, around off. Liam Doherty stays back and steers it towards third man for a single. Ireland Under-19 are up and running!
Touch fuller this time, around off. Liam Doherty leans and drives it towards cover.
Rajvardhan Hangargekar begins with a length ball, outside off. Liam Doherty defends it out.
